text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Known as the dream of all Umamusume, the 
Tokyo Yushun (Japanese Derby). In the 
preliminary popularity poll, Admire Vega 
missed the top favorite spot for the first 
time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The one who claimed that spot was Narita 
Top Road. Admire Vega watched her strive 
with all her might, driven solely by the 
desire to live up to everyone's 
expectations.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Receiving encouragement from Special Week, 
who was blessed with great rivals as part 
of the Golden Generation—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega finally stood on the Nippon 
Derby track, her heart genuinely 
fluttering with excitement at the prospect 
of clashing with her rivals.
